data.title: bn-1gle: tolerate tokio worker pre-rename comm in birth checks
data.description: Race fix (user-approved): a tokio worker caught before prctl renames it keeps the executable comm. Tolerate it in bind_birth_group (producer-runtime, spawn_blocking) and the _roles replay (expected_comms + producer/publication birth-comm checks). role_rules descriptive config unchanged. New positive replay test. unittest 47/47, runner 163/163, verifier 187/187, evaluator SELF_TEST_PASS.

data.reason: APPROVED (user-directed race tolerance). Mechanism verified: tokio sets worker names via prctl in-thread after spawn (tokio builder default), so a pre-rename snapshot shows the inherited process comm. Fix covers BOTH validation paths (live bind_birth_group + _roles replay: expected_comms, producer_births, terminal_births), tolerating executable_comm only for the tokio-worker roles; owner/committer comm checks unchanged; role_rules config parity with evidence_schema preserved. New test asserts a mid-rename producer worker is accepted. All suites green. open_findings=0
